title: 有馬記念の後に・変わらない強さ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Neither Hishi Amazon nor Narita Brian win the Arima Kinen, but Narita Brian attracts a lot of attention with her outstanding performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon channels her frustration into her workout. She vows to get a proper rematch against Narita Brian at the Arima Kinen next year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After talking it over, we decide to set the Osaka Hai as our next goal, and it's going to be first place or bust!
